limitations: No per-file sample sheet exists; file-to-sample mapping is derived from MaxQuant evidence.txt Experiment plus file-name tokens (CE, NP, NF1, OffGel, TiO2_Digest, Ti, Phospho, PIPE) whose meaning is not defined in the paper.
CE/NP are likely cytoplasmic/nuclear fractions but this is not stated; they appear only as literal tokens in source names.
Precursor tolerance, passage number, culture medium, storage temperature, ancestry and developmental stage are not available.
Induction medium composition is not stated in the paper text; treatment is described generically.
Fragment tolerance for Velos HCD files assumes Orbitrap detection.

Tokens CE, NP, NF1 and 'untagged' (20100723 OffGel files without a compartment token) are kept literally in source names; the paper says lysates were split into nuclear and cytoplasmic fractions but never defines the tokens. NF1 occurs only in replicate 2 (1_24) where no NP gel series exists and is probably nuclear; not merged.
Lys-C was used before trypsin for in-solution (phospho) digests per Methods, but comment[cleavage agent details] is single-valued; Trypsin (matching MaxQuant Trypsin/P) is recorded for all rows.
reconcile BLOCKER cleavage_agent_unsupported refers only to the PRIDE record; trypsin is named in the paper Methods and the MaxQuant summary.txt.

Round-2 fix: fraction identifiers use the authors' MaxQuant evidence.txt Fraction; all technical replicate = 1. Phospho series of rep3 acquired on 20120812 (CE/NP x_1-4 + PIPE) and 20120817 (Phospho*) are separate sources ('phospho0812'/'phospho0817') because both reuse fractions 1-5; nothing states whether they are repeats or separate preparations.

Phospho/TiO2 files have comment[fractionation method] not available: Methods say 'enriched and fractionated using TiO2' without naming a separate fractionation technique. OffGel series (rep1) likewise not available; OffGel is not mentioned in the paper (name suggests isoelectric focusing).
